## 1) DaVinci V300 AI Core — exact chip name & datasheet

**"DaVinci V300" (DaVinciV300) is the 3rd‑generation DaVinci AI‑core IP, not a standalone chip.** It is integrated inside the **HiSilicon Ascend 310B (昇腾310B)** AI processor, whose internal/board name is **Hi1910B** (chip silkscreen reads "Hi1910"). Each Ascend 310B carries **1× DaVinciV300 AI core + 1× DaVinciV300 Vector core** [[333]][[335]].

- Core characteristics: 3D Cube + Vector + Scalar units; **4096 FP16 MACs/cycle** (16×16×16 Cube), 8192 INT8 MACs/cycle; at **1.224 GHz → 10 TFLOPS FP16 / 20 TOPS INT8** [[35]][[458]].
- Hi1910B ↔ Ascend 310B identity is confirmed by the device‑tree `hi1910B-*.dts` (compatible `"hisilicon,hi1910B-evb"`, model `"Hisilicon PhosphorHi1910B evb"`) and the Orange Pi board silkscreen "Hi1910" [[111]][[126]][[463]].
- **Datasheet:** *Ascend 310B 芯片硬件指南 (Chip Hardware Guide)* — bbs.16rd.com/thread-628152-1-1.html; Atlas 200I A2 规格/用户指南 (Huawei support); Orange Pi AI Pro User Manual.

## 2) DaVinci V300 AI Processor — exact name & datasheet

**Exact name: Ascend 310B (Hi1910B)** — a multi‑core SoC / PCIe‑device AI processor for mid/high‑performance AI [[333]]. Bins: **Ascend310B1 = 20 TOPS INT8 / 10 TFLOPS FP16** (CPU @1.6 GHz); **Ascend310B4 = 8 TOPS / 4 TFLOPS** (CPU @1.0 GHz) [[458]][[13]].

Full specs: 1× DaVinciV300 AI + 1× Vector core, **4× TaiShanV200M (ARMv8‑A)**, Mali‑G52 GPU, 4× ISP, H.264/H.265 enc 16–24ch / dec 32–40ch FHD30, **96‑bit LPDDR4X up to 4266 Mbps (max 24 GB)**, 256 KB SRAM, L3 3 MB, GE/PCIe/USB/SATA/CAN‑FD, SEC crypto [[333]][[335]]. Products: **Atlas 200I A2 module, Atlas 200I DK A2 kit, Orange Pi AIpro (8T/20T)** [[98]][[463]].
- **Datasheets:** Ascend 310B hardware guide (16rd), Atlas 200I A2 docs (support.huawei.com EDOC1100355983 / EDOC1100388657), Orange Pi AI Pro manual, Tsingetech 昇腾310B module datasheet.

## 3) TaiShan V200M CPU — name & datasheet

**TaiShan V200M (TaishanV200M / 泰山V200M)** = HiSilicon custom **64‑bit ARMv8‑A** core (the embedded "M" variant of the TaiShan V200 family). **4 cores inside Ascend 310B**; **16 cores @ up to 1.9 GHz** in Atlas 200I SoC A1 [[37]][[44]][[434]].

Micro‑architecture: superscalar out‑of‑order, full ARMv8‑A, TrustZone, SVE/NEON, VFPv4, PMUv3, CPU virtualization, 256‑bit coherent fabric (Skyros/MOESI); **L1 64 KB I + 64 KB D (ECC), L2 512 KB/core, L3 3 MB** [[333]][[335]]. Frequencies: 1.6 GHz (20T) / 1.0 GHz (8T) [[458]][[186]].
- **Datasheet:** Ascend 310B hardware guide (processor features); Atlas 200I SoC A1 User Guide (EDOC1100288551). ⚠️ Distinct from **TaiShan v110** (the Kunpeng 920 server core) [[196]].

## 4) ebaina.com — Hi1910B kernel version & development kit

I searched ebaina's **live search API** (`/search/down`, `/search/articles`, `/search/ask`). **Result: ebaina has no dedicated Hi1910B datasheet/kernel/dev‑kit page.** Closest items:
- Q&A **"昇腾310B有用过的吗？原厂能提供支持吗？"** → ebaina.com/ask/100000053567 (answer: Huawei supports it, but threshold ~¥20–30M; no kernel/kit data).
- Resource **"Atlas 200 sdk 21.0.1版本"** → ebaina.com/down/240000037754 (this is **Ascend 310 / Hi1910**, not 310B).
- Article **"华为达芬奇架构NPU为什么聪明？"** → ebaina.com/articles/140000004532 (DaVinci 3D Cube, 4096 FP16 MAC/cycle).

**Authoritative Hi1910B (Ascend 310B) platform data (Huawei / Orange Pi):**
- **Kernel: Linux 5.10.0** — openEuler 22.03 LTS SP1 (RT example `5.10.0-136.12.0.rt62.59.oe2203sp1`) and Ubuntu 22.04 [[255]][[480]].
- **Development kits: Atlas 200I DK A2** and **Orange Pi AIpro (8T/20T)**; module Atlas 200I A2 [[98]][[221]][[463]].
- **Source/SDK: `Ascend310B-source.tar.gz`** (Euler kernel bundled; DTS dir `dtb/dts/hi1910b/hi1910BL/`); driver `Ascend-hdk-310b-npu-driver-soc_*.run`; CANN `Ascend310B1/B4` [[111]][[201]].
